summary: This is a routine 8-K filing reporting an amendment to an existing credit agreement. Guardian Pharmacy Services, Inc., as borrower, entered into the Eighth Amendment to its loan agreement, which extends the maturity date to 2030, permits up to $80M total borrowing capacity, and adjusts financial covenants. No equity, merger, or special-situation transaction is involved; it is a standard refinancing and covenant reset for a public company. The filing does not describe an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event. The sole purpose is to disclose a material definitive agreement under Item 1.01 and the related debt obligation under Item 2.03. No special-situation category applies.
